sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.24059 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the action of the respondents Nos.4, 6 and 7 in interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner over the land admeasuring Ac.2.00 gts., in Sy.No.750/A, situated at Devarakonda Villaga and Mandal, Nalgonda District, as illegal, arbitrary and for other appropriate reliefs.

2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and perused the record.
3.

It is stated that one Ramanatham is the owner and pattadar of land admeasuring Ac.2.00 gts., in Sy.No.750/A, situated at Devarakonda Villaga and Mandal, Nalgonda District, having purchased the same under a registered sale deed vide Document No.236 of 1981, dated 09.03.1981.

It is also stated that thereafter, the Ramanatha and others entered into partnership deed as per the provisions of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932, to construct oil mill in the name of M/s. Sri Gayatri Neem Oil Mill.

4. The case of the respondents is that part of the said land to an extent of Ac.0.20 gts., is the government land and the petitioner is in encroachment of the said land describing the wrong boundaries.

It is ::2::
the further case of the respondents that the petitioner is making efforts to encroach the government land, wherein, the government has allotted Ac.0.20 gts., of the land in Sy.No.751/1 for the purpose of construction of Indoor Stadium.

5. Mr. Ponnam Ashok Goud, learned counsel appearing for impleaded respondent No.8 has vehemently contended that the boundaries described in the sale deed produced by the petitioner and the land allotted by the government for construction of Indoor Stadium is totally different and therefore, the petitioner is not having any rights to stall the construction activities being taken up by the government for constructing the sport stadium.
6.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 4 has not disputed the fact that the land purchased by the petitioner vide registered sale deed vide Document No.236 of 1981, dated 09.03.1981.
7.
The only dispute in this writ petition is with regard to the identification of the boundaries and extent of the lands in Sy.Nos.750/1 and 750/A.

To put a quietus to the litigation, the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records, is directed to conduct survey of the lands as per the sale deed to be produced by the petitioner, within a period of two (02) weeks from today and if the land M/S Sri Gayathri Neem Oil Mill vs State Of Telangana on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64607484/
1 allotted by the Government is not forming part of the land purchased ::3::
by the petitioner under registered sale deed, then respondent No.8 is entitled to proceed with the construction of Sports Stadium.
